The mechanism appears to involve the inhibition of enzymes that are part of a broader network targeting the Inner centromere protein, possibly through the modulation of metabolic or signaling pathways. The presence of multiple targets and their shared downstream effect on the Inner centromere protein supports the hypothesis that Tiapride may influence centromere-related processes.
